changes.to: Maker product page (digit.com.cn/ProductsDetail/171.html): Nezha (星行侠) P01 is a highly customizable interaction robot with 'dual-mode, wheel and leg separable' mobility, hands-on teaching, an emotional-intelligence dialogue model, elevator control, long battery life and remote management through the JuHao app, and appearance/hands/voice customization. The maker publishes no height, weight, DoF, speed, runtime or price on the page, so specs stay empty. Manufacturer note: digit.com.cn is 数字华夏（深圳）科技有限公司 (Digital Huaxia); this record and digital-huaxia-xingxingxia-p02 are the same maker under two spellings, and 'Digit Robotics' comes from aggregator listings.
Digital Huaxia's customizable dual-mode service humanoid (Nezha / 星行侠 P01) that can switch between walking legs and a wheeled base, managed through the company's JuHao app.
